response.justification: The candidate lacks critical experience in C programming for UNIX, Linux kernel modification, and embedded networking security features required for this role. While they have extensive experience in web and application development (JavaScript, TypeScript, DLang) and general software engineering, there is no evidence of work with embedded systems, switch chip knowledge, or security technologies like MACsec or IEEE 802.1X. Their background does not align closely enough with the embedded networking security domain.
strengths: Strong software engineering background with diverse language experience (C, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, DLang)
Proven ability to work in collaborative and agile environments
Experience with performance optimization and low-latency systems
concerns: No direct experience with C programming for UNIX or embedded systems
Lacks evidence of Linux kernel modification or embedded firmware development
No demonstrated experience with networking security protocols (MACsec, 802.1X) or embedded networking technologies

key_factors.factor: Embedded C programming for UNIX/Linux kernel
